verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's pricing page offers "$5 free credit for new users. No credit card required." The get-started docs describe a self-serve path: install the SDK, create a team-scoped API key, and start building with transparent per-second billing and no sales step. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the signup and credit flow, and an explicit documented self-serve signup walkthrough or statement that sales contact is not needed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales

citations.quote: $5 free credit for new users. No credit card required.
If you want to use the SDKs or raw HTTP API, create a team-scoped API key and export it as SANDBOX0_TOKEN.
No one-hour compute minimum. Paused sandboxes incur storage charges only.
